sources.verified_claim: Product specifications list geographic WGS84, vertical EGM96 and meters. Assignment to local copies depends on their recorded provenance.
sources.limitation: Does not prove exact tile version, local fill source or physical accuracy.

sources.verified_claim: Version 3 is void-filled; per-pixel provenance is carried in the companion SRTMGL1N product.
sources.limitation: Companion NUM data not acquired; no observation-vs-fill mask is claimed for this analysis.

sources.access: Phase-1 snapshots, complete IMG and C orthoimage acquired in phase 2
sources.verified_claim: Specific source product identity and grid established by embedded DTM and detached image labels.
Stereo DTM is a derived product with potential processing artifacts; grid spacing does not establish local accuracy.
Atacama has rover research context, but this project polygon was not identified as an ARADS footprint.

conflicts.resolution: Separate validity/support masks; no direct-observation fraction is inferred
